title.narrative: Sustaining the Growth of China’s Green Bond Market and Facilitating Inter-Country Green Capital Flows

description.narrative:
1 Harmonising green definitions and green bond standards
2 Scaling up green bond issuance at local level and connecting with international markets
3 Developing green asset-backed securities (ABS) and tracking the progress of China’s green bond market
Green Bond Investment and Issuance Sector

The project will achieve further harmonisation of green definitions and green bond standards in China with international standards by: identifying green investment opportunities, scaling up green bond issuance at local level, and facilitating green capital flows between the UK and China.
